notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Live!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/iNk3zMD.gif
Animal collectors!

We've heard your requests and are happy to announce that Update 1.1.0 is now live and adds some great controller customization options to Uurnog Uurnlimited!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30494326/76d4cd712696c8e67af669517aefe73ce873fd1e.png

You'll be able to re-map the controls for either gamepad or keyboard.

Enjoy! 

PS: Have you found the Uurnog yet?
